test_cases.summary:
Verify Reviewer can view Approval configuration
when the user has Reviewer role
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Reviewer can view Approval configuration
Given the user has Reviewer role
When the user navigates to Session Creation page
Then the Approval Level section should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The Approval Level section should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates to Session Creation page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Default Approval state
when the Approval Level section is visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Default Approval state
Given the Approval Level section is visible
When the page loads
Then only the “Add Level” button should be displayed by default
test_cases.acceptance:
Only the "Add Level" button should be displayed by default
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Add Level interaction
when the reviewer is on Session Creation page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Add Level interaction
Given the reviewer is on Session Creation page
When the user clicks the Add Level button
Then Level 1 approval field should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Level 1 approval field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Add Level button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Multiple Add Level visibility
when Level 1 is already added
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Multiple Add Level visibility
Given Level 1 is already added
When the reviewer clicks Add Level again
Then the next sequential level field should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The next sequential level field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the reviewer clicks Add Level again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Non-reviewer cannot view approval section
when the user does not have Reviewer role
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Non-reviewer cannot view approval section
Given the user does not have Reviewer role
When the user opens Session Creation page
Then the Approval Level section should not be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The Approval Level section should not be visible
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Session Creation page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Non-reviewer cannot configure approval levels
when a non-reviewer is logged in
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Non-reviewer cannot configure approval levels
Given a non-reviewer is logged in
When the user attempts to add or edit approval levels
Then the action should be disabled or blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
The action should be disabled or blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to add or edit approval levels.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Direct access restriction
when a non-reviewer user
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Direct access restriction
Given a non-reviewer user
When the user attempts to access approval configuration via direct URL or API
Then the system should block access with authorization restriction
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block access with authorization restriction
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to access approval configuration via direct URL or API.

test_cases.summary:
Verify UI clarity for reviewer
when the reviewer views the Approval Level section
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: UI clarity for reviewer
Given the reviewer views the Approval Level section
When the section is displayed
Then Add Level button should be clearly enabled and clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
Add Level button should be clearly enabled and clickable
The behavior should be validated when the section is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Role change effect
when a reviewer role is changed to non-reviewer
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Role change effect
Given a reviewer role is changed to non-reviewer
When the user refreshes the page
Then Approval Level section should no longer be accessible
test_cases.acceptance:
Approval Level section should no longer be accessible
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Secure rendering
when the page is loading for a non-reviewer
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Access Control
Scenario: Secure rendering
Given the page is loading for a non-reviewer
When UI renders
Then approval controls should never briefly appear during load
test_cases.acceptance:
Approval controls should never briefly appear during load
The behavior should be validated when UI renders.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Level 1 appears after Add Level click
when the reviewer is on Session Creation page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Level 1 Approval Initialization
Scenario: Level 1 appears after Add Level click
Given the reviewer is on Session Creation page
When the user clicks the Add Level button
Then Level 1 approval section should be displayed immediately
test_cases.acceptance:
Level 1 approval section should be displayed immediately
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Add Level button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Level 1 is fixed first level
when the user clicks Add Level for the first time
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Level 1 is fixed first level
Given the user clicks Add Level for the first time
When the level is created
Then the level label should be “Level 1” and should not allow skipping or reordering
test_cases.acceptance:
The level label should be "Level 1" and should not allow skipping or reordering
The behavior should be validated when the level is created.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Approver selection field visible
when Level 1 is displayed
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Approver selection field visible
Given Level 1 is displayed
When the section loads
Then an approver selection dropdown/multi-select field should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
An approver selection dropdown/multi-select field should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the section loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User can select Level 1 approver
when the approver dropdown is available
test_cases.description:
Scenario: User can select Level 1 approver
Given the approver dropdown is available
When the user selects one or more approvers
Then selected approvers should be displayed and retained in the field
test_cases.acceptance:
Selected approvers should be displayed and retained in the field
The behavior should be validated when the user selects one or more approvers.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Submission blocked without approver
when Level 1 is added
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Submission blocked without approver
Given Level 1 is added
And no approver is selected
When the user clicks Submit/Create Session
Then session submission should be blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
Session submission should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Submit/Create Session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Validation message displayed for empty Level 1
when no approver is selected for Level 1
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Validation message displayed for empty Level 1
Given no approver is selected for Level 1
When the user attempts to submit
Then a clear validation message should be displayed indicating Level 1 approver is mandatory
test_cases.acceptance:
A clear validation message should be displayed indicating Level 1 approver is mandatory
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to submit.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Submission allowed with valid approver
when Level 1 approver is selected
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Submission allowed with valid approver
Given Level 1 approver is selected
When the user clicks Submit/Create Session
Then the session should be created successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The session should be created successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Submit/Create Session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Selected approver retained during navigation
when Level 1 approver is selected
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Selected approver retained during navigation
Given Level 1 approver is selected
When the user navigates within the form or scrolls
Then the selected approver value should remain unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
The selected approver value should remain unchanged
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates within the form or scrolls.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Approver stored in payload
when Level 1 approver is selected
test_cases.description:
Scenario: Approver stored in payload
Given Level 1 approver is selected
When the session is submitted
Then the selected approver should be included in the session creation payload
test_cases.acceptance:
The selected approver should be included in the session creation payload
The behavior should be validated when the session is submitted.

test_cases.acceptance:
